facts.note: When the temple bell struck nine, Aurèle had everyone bring out watches, and the narrator's watch is stated to be two minutes ahead of the bell.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by the narrator's watch; he then went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after he sat down again.
